description:
Configure the global system message in JFrog Artifactory to broadcast an upcoming maintenance window. 

Log in to Artifactory (http://localhost:8082, admin/password). Navigate to Administration > General > System Message. 

Enable the system message and set the following details exactly:
- Message: "Scheduled Maintenance: Saturday, Oct 24th at 02:00 UTC. System will be read-only."
- Severity/Color: Warn (Orange)

Save the configuration and ensure the banner appears at the top of the screen.

metadata.expected_message: Scheduled Maintenance: Saturday, Oct 24th at 02:00 UTC. System will be read-only.
